text:
pagerduty-bot: PAGER: SEV=1 — GPU capacity exhausted in prod (us-west-2). Autoscaler failing to add nodes. Affected: inference-pool-prod. Pager pinned to SRE oncall.

Alex: acked. I'm on it. Seeing queue growth on inference-pool-prod, tokens/sec dropping. Dashboard: https://redwood.ops/infra/queues?id=inference-pool-prod

Maya: also getting 503s in frontend metrics? @Customer Ops any reports?

Customer Ops: customer-facing alert — a subset of high-throughput customers seeing 5xxs and timeouts. No broad account outages yet. Logging 20-30% request failures for embeddings paths.

Alex: Autocaler metrics show scale events failing with 'scale limit reached' and repeated 409s from cloud quota API. Checking autoscaler logs now.

SRE Bot: autoscaler/error — 2026-03-15T08:02:11Z — Failed to create instance: QUOTA_EXCEEDED. Recent failures: 24 in 10m

Jim: hmm. Cloud quotas look ok earlier. Is this per-project quota or per-region? I'll pull instance creation logs.

DevOps: quick check — we've got a stealth patch in the driver rollout that dropped alive node count by ~12. Some nodes flapped and were marked unschedulable by k8s due to driver crash loop.

Maya: driver crash logs show repeated CUDA/Xid 13 and OOMs in the runtime on nodes gpu-nn-11..14. Suspect kernel module regressions from last driver config.

Alex: timeline — root cause sequence looks like: driver rollout -> node flaps (OOM/CUDA Xid) -> node Taints -> autoscaler tries to replace nodes -> cloud quota error -> queue grows -> requests 503 -> customers impacted.

Carmen: immediate mitigation suggestions?

Jim: 1) Pause driver rollout (rollback to previous driver config). 2) Cordon affected nodes so pods migrate. 3) Temporarily increase autoscaler max for critical pool (if quota allows) or fallback to another region.

Maya: rolling back driver now. Command:
```
kubectl set image ds/gpu-driver gpu-driver=redwood-gpu-driver:v1.4.3
kubectl rollout status daemonset/gpu-driver -n infra
```

Alex: I'm starting a manual drain on the flapping nodes with --ignore-daemonsets, evicting long-running pods to other pools. Will reduce batching to lower per-request GPU memory.

SRE Bot: kube events: evicting pods from gpu-nn-11..14. Node status transitions to Ready on 3/4 nodes after rollback.

DevOps: FYI — there's a soft quota we hit due to autoscaler re-tries causing parallel instance requests. I've opened a support ticket with cloud provider (ticket #CLD-85732) to request temporary quota bump.

Customer Ops: Notifying a small set of affected customers as degraded performance. Message sent at 08:18 PT. Monitor for further 5xx spikes.

Alex: temp measures in order: 1) rollback driver (done) 2) manual node drains + pod reschedules (in progress) 3) reduce model batch size config for critical routes (deployed) 4) adjust autoscaler parallelism to 1 to avoid quota storms (done).

Maya: model batching config snippet applied:
```
batch.size.max=8
batch.max_latency_ms=60
```
This brought memory pressure down on warmed pods.

Jim: we're seeing instance creation success after throttling parallelism — 6 new nodes came up in the past 6 minutes. Autoscaler stabilized.

Alex: queue length back to baseline at 08:38 PT. Token throughput recovering. Still monitoring driver logs for residual XIDs.

SRE Bot: incident note auto: capacity restored, restart/rollback mitigations worked. Recommend postmortem.

Carmen: assigning follow-up owners: postmortem (Maya), cloud quota liaison (DevOps), rollout gating (Jim). I'll open incident tracker.

Customer Ops: customers notified and status page updated. No escalations yet. Will keep CS looped.

Alex: clean-up tasks — remove temporary autoscaler max overrides once cloud confirms quota is stable. Leave driver pinned until next canary tests pass.

Maya: collecting driver logs and crash dumps for postmortem. Will upload to /s3/incidents/4642001122/ and link in the postmortem draft.

Jim: triage notes: suspected regression in driver v1.5.0 with lingering allocations under high batch concurrency causing OOM -> Xid. Add regression test under stress harness.

Alex: thanks team. Paging cleared. :white_check_mark:

pagerduty-bot: RESOLVE: Incident acknowledged and mitigated. Close if no further regressions.

Carmen: closing the pager for now. Will follow up with postmortem and RCA. Good recovery — 30m to mitigation.
